technicalAspects.aspect: Outcome, authorization, activation, complete model and import ownership
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Description promises migration but workflow ends at planning/offer script; hard-coded confirm complete model can re-ask already supplied authorization. Direct interop narrows migration to mapping and leaves actual durable execution/reconciliation owner unstated.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Migration owns authorized transformation/import/rerun/reconciliation; reuse accepted model and authority, stop only missing dependent fact/action.

technicalAspects.aspect: Generated workflow overview, dynamic enum choices and promised outputs
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Config-first sequencing useful for unknown schema, but repeated every-collection confirmation is unconditional. Direct assignment field schema snippets omit explicit import despite copy-ready instruction. User-approved fixed enum should not be reopened.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Unify source/generated path, minimum input and accepted decision reuse; distinguish config, plan, execution and verified result.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Accepted enum is preserved; sufficient authorized input reaches import without unrelated confirmation.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Field schema universal base and type fidelity
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Pseudo BaseField claims all fields require name, conflicting with layout fields; hidden comment says admin-only though field.hidden also removes default API output. label and callback types are narrowed too far for current public Field union.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use Payload exported types and clearly illustrative subset, not complete schema; distinguish admin.hidden from field.hidden.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Generated complete config typechecks with unnamed layout fields and intended visibility.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.basis: Text/textarea/number/checkbox properties mostly match. Email does not support copied minLength/maxLength options. Unix timestamp conversion new Date(timestamp) treats number as milliseconds; seconds require scaling. Dates need source timezone and null policy.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Remove unsupported Email props; explicit seconds/ms/ISO/date-only branches; validate absent/null/value before coercion.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Seconds1700000000 and milliseconds1700000000000 produce same intended instant; nullable value preserved.

technicalAspects.aspect: Rich text editor config, HTML/Markdown/Slate/AST conversion
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Payload richText requires configured editor, not raw HTML; Lexical is default template choice, not magic acceptance of HTML. Converters require actual editor configuration. HTML img and Markdown URLs are not auto-uploaded to Payload.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Choose installed editor, transform source shape, preimport/remap media and internal links; unknown nodes reported as incomplete rather than silently dropped.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Formatting, internal relation and embedded media render after restart; unknown node or failed media prevents complete claim.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed
